description: This file contains the implementation of the EmailReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve email message data from the database. It includes data mapping, retrieval of all emails, emails by status, pending, sent, delivered, and failed emails, with support for pagination and filtering by date.

classes.name: EmailMapper
classes.description: Inner class that implements RowMapper to map SQL ResultSet rows to EmailData objects.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all email records from the database.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single email record by its resource ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllPending
methods.description: Retrieves all pending email messages filtered by status.

methods.name: retrieveAllSent
methods.description: Retrieves all sent email messages filtered by status.

methods.name: retrieveExternalIdsOfAllSent
methods.description: Retrieves external IDs of all sent email messages, limited by the provided limit.

methods.name: retrieveAllDelivered
methods.description: Retrieves all delivered email messages, limited by the provided limit.

methods.name: retrieveAllFailed
methods.description: Retrieves all failed email messages filtered by status.

methods.name: retrieveEmailByStatus
methods.description: Fetches email data by status with optional date filtering and pagination.
